title.en: An Act Revising the Charter of the Philippine National Bank
title.orig: An Act to Add New Section to be Known as Section Nine-A to Republic Act Numbered One Thousand and Three Hundred, Entitled “An Act Revising the Charter of the Philippine National Bank”

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1956/ra_1576_1956.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: All Acts or parts of Acts inconsistent or incompatible with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1956
